errors.text: The hypothesis changes the target material from equiatomic FeNiCrMn to CoCrFeMnNi.
It substitutes a free-surface nanowire nucleation mechanism for the target bulk periodic model, where nucleation initiates at vacancy clusters or disordered atoms.
It suggests a true FCC-to-HCP transformation despite the target finding that HCP-like atoms arise locally from stacking faults without a bulk phase transformation.
It fails to identify the <-111> loading direction as producing the maximum yield stress.

The cited evidence concerns a different CoNiCrFeMn nanowire system, and part of E1 specifically describes an Ag nanowire; it therefore cannot establish the mechanism in the target FeNiCrMn bulk simulation.
